sentences.text: It is further submitted that appellant so far suffered 07 years and 11 months' incarceration as pre and post trial confinement.
It is further submitted that appellant has been falsely implicated in the case, infact, it is a case of consent.
Prosecutrix was major and married lady whereas appellant was also 2 CRA-5882-2025 major and married.
They both are first cousin and share neighbourhood.
Course of events as unfolded by the prosecutrix indicates improbable events.

It is highly improbable that in the mid-night from her rooftop when prosecutrix was sleeping with other family members, she was forcibly abducted by the appellant by putting towel on her face and taken to the agriculture field where alleged offence was committed.
It is also submitted that medical report belies the allegations as no injuries were found over the person of the prosecutrix.
Story of prosecution indicates improbable events.
It is a case of consent prima facie.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the respondents/ State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of the application.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and record perused.
6.

Considering the rival submissions advanced specially the fact that no injury was sustained by the prosecutrix whereas as per prosecution, injuries ought to have been sustained by the prosecutrix as well as the fact that prosecutrix is major and married lady and story prima facie indicates improbable course of events and appellant so far suffered 07 years and 11 months' incarceration and in the facts and obtaining circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court intends to allow the present application but with certain stringent conditions,
hence, I.A. No. 21595/2025 is allowed .

It is directed that appellant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court and appellant's jail sentence 3 CRA-5882-2025 shall remain suspended till disposal of this appeal.
Appellant is further directed to remain present before the Registry of this Court on 06/04/2026 and, thereafter, on such subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry.
7. Appellant is directed to mark his presence before the concerning Police Station on 1st Sunday of every alternate month for next 02 years i.e. till March, 2028.

8. The appellant shall not move in the vicinity of complainant side and shall not be a source of embarrassment or harassment in any manner, otherwise benefit of grant of suspension of jail sentence shall stand cancelled automatically without any reference to the Court.
9.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
10. Copy of this order be sent to the Trial Court concerned for information and necessary compliance.
(ANAND PATHAK) (ANIL VE
JUDGE JUDGE
